verses.1: Remember that you go before God, and all things are in His hand; and you shall stand, by the deeds you have done, to be judged before Him.
verses.2: For likewise He beholds the children of men, the evil and the foolish; and there is none among them who is great or mighty, and their standing and the greatness of their seed; and they did not remember God before them, nor did they know that He is their Creator, who brought them out of nothing.
verses.3: But their fathers, while the faithful angels were giving praise with the angels in heaven, when He drew them out in their desire, they fell into the judgment of everlasting condemnation.
verses.4: And they took wives from among the daughters of men, for God had created flesh for them as a helpmate for man, that He might test them concerning the pride of their heart, and to instruct them whether they would keep His commandment and His law.
verses.5: But they did not keep the commandment, and He cast them down into the judgment of the fire of hell with the devil their father; and because of them the days of men were shortened, for God was wroth with the angels who sinned like men.
verses.6: And He made the children of men swear with them, and cast them down into Sheol in their own judgment.
verses.7: But the former days of men, while they were yet in the two thousand years—for the days of man were shortened because of the angels who went astray with the daughters of Cain.
verses.8: And God said, My spirit shall not abide with them, for they are flesh and blood.
verses.9: And because of this our days were shortened; and there are also those who die while they are infants, for our days were diminished from those of our former fathers because of our sin and our transgression.
verses.10: But as for our fathers, their days were long, for they kept His commandment and did not provoke God.
verses.11: And they admonished their daughters to teach them, and they admonished their husbands not to transgress the commandment of God.
verses.12: And because of this their days were long in righteousness, because they did not transgress the commandment of God, together with their sons and their daughters.
